svg.title: Compact hub: three regions of eighteen Support
svg.desc: Three cities occupy the west, mixed districts the northeast, and small districts fan across the southeast. Shared border segments define adjacency; corners do not. Bellweather Centre borders all three regions.
svg.text: Urban: 18 / 9 votes Mixed: 18 / 9 votes Outlying: 18 / 9 votes Centre: 3 separate Support
Circles = Support spaces. Heavy lines = region borders. Thin lines = district borders.
Concept only · District elections remain local · Territory size does not indicate capacity
